description: Defines a custom Android ViewGroup layout called FixedGridLayout that arranges child views in a fixed-size grid, with configurable cell dimensions. Implements onMeasure and onLayout to position children in a grid layout.

classes.name: FixedGridLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that arranges its child views in a grid with specified cell dimensions. Provides methods to set cell width and height, and overrides onMeasure and onLayout to position children accordingly.

methods.name: FixedGridLayout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the layout with context.

methods.name: FixedGridLayout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the layout with context and XML attributes, reading cell width and height from styleable attributes.

methods.name: setCellWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of each cell and requests layout update.

methods.name: setCellHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of each cell and requests layout update.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the size of the layout and its children based on cell dimensions and child count.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions child views in a grid pattern based on calculated rows and columns.
